scope: Final TREB production database QA only; does not weaken locked regression/canary tests.

locked_regressions.note: Steven Adams 2016-17 and other designated gold-standard regressions remain exact on all locked fields.

production_seconds.condition: A seconds discrepancy is tolerance-eligible only if it does not alter attribution of any rebound event, team identity, tenure boundary, or lineup membership at a rebound timestamp.

production_rebounds.acceptance_rule: Only accept unresolved rebound uncertainty when the mathematically worst-case assignment of every unresolved rebound cannot change any affected published metric by more than 0.01 percentage points for the relevant aggregate.

never_tolerated_when_material: lineup error that changes rebound attribution
